_what: The external pins of each board as a review enumerated them from the board's netlist, held by port_protect.py (rule TRN-001) against the board table's declaration pin by pin: a reviewed pin declared internal, left out or moved to ground, and a declared external pin no review holds, each read INCONCLUSIVE by name until this file is changed with its reason and the review it rests on (a `changes` entry: entry, was, now, why of 40 characters or more, review, on). One writer: the review that enumerated the set, filed by the integrator. A change here makes the readings of TRN-001 stale, as a change to a board table does (rules_status.CONFIG_INPUTS).
